newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Brown ups CKE Restaurants.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Brown ups CKE Restaurants.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it boosted CKE Restaurants Inc to strong buy from neutral.
-- Analyst Steve Rockwell said he initiated an earnings estimate of $1.30 per share for the fiscal year ending January 1998 and retained his estimate of $1.00 for fiscal 1997.
-- Rockwell cited two reasons for the upgrade. He said CKE has "very strong near-term momentum driven by above industry average increases in same-store sales."
-- Secondly, he said he expected the company to be able to sustain a "30 percent plus growth rate for the next three to five years" through unit expansion, same-store sales growth and acquisitions.
